rw [Infimum] at *: Infimum : A real number is the infimum of a set if it is the greatest lower bound that is less than or equal to every element in the set.
apply le_antisymm (bInf.right a aInf.lef: And.left : From a conjunction of two propositions, it is possible to extract and prove the first proposition.
le_antisymm : This theorem establishes that in a partial order, if one element is less than or equal to another and vice versa, then the two elements must be equal.
And.right : This theorem allows for the extraction of the second component from a conjunction when given a proof of that conjunction.
